description: This file defines a utility class GCUtils for managing garbage collection and memory retries in an Android application, including methods for performing operations with memory retries and invoking garbage collection.

classes.name: GCUtils
classes.description: A utility class for managing garbage collection and memory-related operations, including retries and forced GC calls.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GCUtils.

methods.name: performOperationWithMemRetry
methods.description: Attempts to perform a memory-related operation, retrying and invoking garbage collection if an OutOfMemoryError occurs.

methods.name: doGarbageCollection
methods.description: Performs garbage collection and pauses the thread for a specified interval.
